original.statement: Loki adds a metrics.go log line for requests from querier to ingester.

decision.reason: [ev-833d940f9c35] says only that Loki adds a metrics.go log line for requests from the querier to the ingester. That is a new log output, not wire or protocol behaviour such as TLS, ALPN, path matching or signing, so the protocol-behavior subject is a misclassification. None of the other subject families (config, flag, API, gate, image and so on) fits an added log line. No correct typed assertion follows from this changelog entry.
